definition: Served to containers beside this one; pod-network traffic, ports unpublished.

seams.callers: FRONT (ROLE=front), across the pod network. No other caller is declared.
seams.note: todo.list is PULL. The four mutations are PUSH and require an operationId; receipts live in the same SQLite database as the todos, because a receipt that outlives its process but not its database lies after a restore.

exposure.evidence: Measured 2026-09-07 from server.js: BACK binds HOST (default 127.0.0.1) and nothing in this repo publishes a container port. The seam is reached by FRONT at BACK_CPCP_ORIGIN, which defaults to loopback.
exposure.note: This block proves a negative -- that the seam adds no publication of its own. Rule 4 wants that measured like any other claim.

invariants: FRONT cannot write a todo except through this seam: it imports no store and opens no database, so bypassing is not a discipline but an impossibility.
A retry of the same operationId is the same write. The receipt is the record of that, and it is durable because it shares the database with the state it protects.
A refused PUSH writes no receipt, so correcting the input and retrying the same intent proceeds rather than replaying the refusal.
